nm-pubchem-props.cite: PubChem compound records: computed properties and experimental sections (PUG REST, PUG-View)
nm-pubchem-props.says: Gives molecular formula, molecular weight, monoisotopic mass, charge, and cited experimental log Kow and boiling points.

cases.title: Properties of acetate
cases.uncertainty: dbe uses the formula convention (2C+2+N+P-H-X)/2 with H adjusted by minus the charge; S=O and P=O are not counted, a structure-based count would differ.

cases.title: Properties of tetrachloromethane
cases.uncertainty: exact_mass is the true monoisotopic mass (lightest isotopes, e.g. 35Cl/79Br) computed from the formula with RDKit isotope table; PubChem's Exact Mass field lists 153.872461 for this record (most-abundant-isotope convention for Cl/Br), which is not monoisotopic.
